real_units.note: These follow from one choice: the barrier height V₀ = 3 is the AlGaAs conduction-band offset, about 0.30 eV for Al₀.₃₅Ga₀.₆₅As (Vurgaftman, Meyer & Ram-Mohan, J. Appl. Phys. 89, 5815, 2001). That fixes the energy unit at 100 meV and, with m* = 0.067 mₑ, the length unit at 3.37 nm. The Fermi sea is at 140 meV and T = 58 K.
